title: Organic Traffic vs. Paid Traffic for Affiliates | Digistore24 Blog

facts.fact: The Digistore24 blog article 'Organic Traffic vs. Paid Traffic for Affiliates' was published on 21 September 2026.
The HubSpot cookie hubspotutk has a maximum storage duration of 180 days and sets a unique ID to obtain visitor behaviour data for statistical purposes.
facts.quote: Maximum Storage Duration**: 180 days**Type**: HTTP Cookie **hubspotutk**

facts.fact: The Vimeo cookie vuid collects data on the user's visits, such as which pages have been read, and has a maximum storage duration of 2 years.
facts.quote: Collects data on the user's visits to the website, such as which pages have been read.

facts.fact: The Twitter cookie personalization_id, set by Twitter, allows visitors to share website content to their Twitter profile and has a maximum storage duration of 400 days.
facts.quote: This cookie is set by Twitter - The cookie allows the visitor to share content from the website onto their Twitter profile.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt cookie sa-user-id-v4 collects visitor data such as number of visits and pages loaded for displaying targeted ads and has a maximum storage duration of 1 year.
facts.quote: with the purpose of displaying targeted ads.

facts.fact: The third-party cookie ablyft_uvs is used to facilitate A/B testing on different offers shown to the user and has a maximum storage duration of 3 months.
facts.quote: Used by third-party marketing platform to facilitate A/B testing on different offers shown to the user

facts.fact: Digistore24's page lists the Google Analytics cookie _gid with a maximum storage duration of 3 months.
facts.quote: **Maximum Storage Duration**: 3 months**Type**: HTTP Cookie **_gid**Used to send data to Google Analytics about the visitor's device and behavior.

facts.fact: The Google DoubleClick cookie IDE has a maximum storage duration of 1 day, according to the page's cookie list.

facts.fact: The Google NID cookie has a maximum storage duration of 400 days, according to the page's cookie list.

facts.quote: **Maximum Storage Duration**: 6 months**Type**: HTTP Cookie **pagead/1p-user-list/#**Tracks if the user has shown interest in specific products or events across multiple websites

facts.fact: The Digistore24-listed _scid cookie has a maximum storage duration of 3 months and is used to let third-party advertisers target the visitor.
facts.quote: **_scid**Sets a unique ID for the visitor, that allows third party advertisers to target the visitor with relevant advertisement.

facts.fact: The PostHog session mirror cookie is written only if the visitor accepts statistics cookies.
facts.quote: Written only if you accept statistics.

facts.fact: The page states that marketing cookies are used to track visitors across websites to display relevant ads.
